delivery.en: Leave it at a Jersey Post SecureDrop porch or shed, or collect at a post office or with a neighbour.
delivery.zh: 包裹放門廊、交給鄰居，或到澤西郵局領取

readback.en: Postcodes start JE, in capitals. 0 as oh, doubles as double; amounts in pounds; half two means 2:30.
readback.zh: JE 郵區須大寫。0 唸 oh，重複唸 double；用英鎊。half two＝2:30

fraud.en: A fake Jersey Post parcel text, or a local Income Tax request for data or payment, is a scam
fraud.zh: 假澤西郵局包裹簡訊，或冒充本地稅務要資料、要付款的都是詐騙

habits.en: British English. Jersey Income Tax and Revenue Jersey, not HMRC. Say mobile and postcode; day first.
habits.zh: 用英式英語。稅務走澤西的 Revenue Jersey，不是 HMRC。說 mobile、postcode。

stall_local.en: I need to open an official Revenue Jersey page, and the bank app will not sign me in.
stall_local.zh: 要到 Revenue Jersey 正式頁面才看得清楚，而且銀行 App 登不進去。

reason.zh: 英國稅務機關，不是澤西的

talk_style_diff.en: Keep British courtesy, but tax is Revenue Jersey, not HMRC, and post is Jersey Post; postcodes start JE.
talk_style_diff.zh: 英式禮貌層級相近，稅務要說 Revenue Jersey 而不是 HMRC，郵局說澤西郵政，郵區是 JE。

uncertain: 此次主要來源是澤西稅務防詐頁；澤西郵局官方防詐專頁未在同一次搜尋中穩定打開。
當地 Jèrriais 不在支援清單，只能當偶發詞。
oh／double、英鎊與 half two 的讀法與英國及其他皇屬地是同一套習慣；此檔已改寫並寫出郵區 JE 須大寫。此次打開的澤西郵政頁未核到區號 01534，故未寫入。
SecureDrop 官頁寫明可指定住地內防風雨位置，並舉 porch、shed、garage 為例。
